criteria.clearly_better_overall: rho_a - rho_b >= 0.05 on the pooled receiver-start records AND the bootstrap 95% interval of rho_a - rho_b excludes 0
criteria.no_worse_in_any_major_group: rho_a >= rho_b - 0.02 in every major group: each stage, each RSR (incl. weak reference), each path regime, each SNR, receiver start, poor start
criteria.per_cell_note: Within a single cell the nominal scale is nearly constant (only S varies), so per-cell rho_b is near zero by construction. Per-cell values are reported but are not part of the gate.

within_cell_stage.note: Spearman within each (cell, stage) group, receiver start; nominal varies only through S.

bias_fraction.definition: 16 channels per main cell (receiver start), 16 independent noise draws per channel with G, S, B fixed. bias_k = ||mean_r g_dc,k - g_k||^2 / N; fraction = sum(bias) / sum(mean_r actual). Small-sample bias correction: subtract (1/R) * within-channel variance.
